in_sanskrit.name: Pradeepkumar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Deep, Light
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pradeepkumar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pradeepkumar is a name composed of two words: Pradeep (meaning deep) and Kumar (meaning young boy). The name evokes the image of a boy who is deep in knowledge, or a man who is deep in wisdom and understanding.
